---
title: "BROWARD Data"
format: html
params: 
  org_id: BROWARD # org_id must be BROWARD before `quarto publish`
  # org_id: BROWARD_STORET  # this dataset has no lat+lon
  # org_id: FIU_WQMP_RECENT  # this dataset has no units

---

```{r generate custom summary for listing}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

# Read the summary data that was saved at the end of this document
summary_file <- here::here("data", "summaries", glue::glue("{params$org_id}_summary.json"))

if (file.exists(summary_file)) {
  summary_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(summary_file)
  
  # Build summary string for listing page
  summary_parts <- c()
  
  # Add basic metrics
  if (!is.null(summary_data$total_records)) {
    summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("{summary_data$total_records:,} records"))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(summary_data$unique_sites)) {
    summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("{summary_data$unique_sites} sites"))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(summary_data$unique_analytes)) {
    summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("{summary_data$unique_analytes} analytes"))
  }
  
  # Add coordinate info
  if (!is.null(summary_data$sites_with_coordinates) && !is.null(summary_data$unique_sites)) {
    coord_ratio <- summary_data$sites_with_coordinates / summary_data$unique_sites
    if (coord_ratio == 1) {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, "📍 All sites have coordinates")
    } else {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("📍 {summary_data$sites_with_coordinates}/{summary_data$unique_sites} sites with coordinates"))
    }
  }
  
  # Add depth info with emoji
  if (!is.null(summary_data$has_depth_data)) {
    if (summary_data$has_depth_data) {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, "📏 Has depth data")
      if (!is.null(summary_data$depth_range)) {
        summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("📏 Depth: {summary_data$depth_range$min}-{summary_data$depth_range$max}m"))
      }
    } else {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, "❌ No depth data")
    }
  }
  
  # Add date range
  if (!is.null(summary_data$earliest_date) && !is.null(summary_data$latest_date)) {
    start_year <- substr(summary_data$earliest_date, 1, 4)
    end_year <- substr(summary_data$latest_date, 1, 4)
    if (start_year == end_year) {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("📅 {start_year}"))
    } else {
      summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("📅 {start_year}-{end_year}"))
    }
  }
  
  # Add warnings if any
  if (!is.null(summary_data$duplicate_records) && summary_data$duplicate_records > 0) {
    summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("⚠️ {summary_data$duplicate_records} duplicates"))
  }
  
  if (!is.null(summary_data$non_standard_analytes) && summary_data$non_standard_analytes > 0) {
    summary_parts <- append(summary_parts, glue("⚠️ {summary_data$non_standard_analytes} non-standard analytes"))
  }
  
  # Set the custom summary for Quarto listing
  custom_summary <- paste(summary_parts, collapse = " • ")
  
} else {
  custom_summary <- "Summary data not available"
}
```

# Quality Checks
```{R, show non-standard analytes}
#| code-summary: show non-standard analytes
# compare unique(df$DEP.Analyte.Name) before & after dropNonStandardAnalytes
source(here::here("R/dropNonStandardAnalytes.R"))
df_dropped_analytes <- dropNonStandardAnalytes(df)

analytes_before <- sort(unique(df$DEP.Analyte.Name))
analytes_after  <- sort(unique(df_dropped_analytes$DEP.Analyte.Name))

analytes_removed <- setdiff(analytes_before, analytes_after)

if (length(analytes_removed) > 0) {
  cat(glue::glue(
    "Non-Standard Analytes Present: {length(analytes_removed)}\n",
  ))
  cat("\nNon-Standard Analytes Removed Before Exporting Data:\n")
  print(analytes_removed)
}
```

```{R create map }
#| code-summary: Map of sampling sites.

# check for missing lat/lon
if (all(is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Latitude)) || all(is.na(df$Org.Decimal.Longitude))) {
  cat("Cannot make map: All rows have missing latitude or longitude.")
} else {
  library(leaflet)
  library(dplyr)

  # 1. Filter out rows & keep only one per unique lat/lon
  df_unique_locs <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Org.Decimal.Latitude), !is.na(Org.Decimal.Longitude)) %>%
    distinct(Org.Decimal.Latitude, Org.Decimal.Longitude, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # 2. Plot all unique points (no clustering)
  leaflet(df_unique_locs) %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$OpenStreetMap) %>%
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng         = ~Org.Decimal.Longitude,
      lat         = ~Org.Decimal.Latitude,
      radius      = 4,
      color       = "blue",
      fillOpacity = 0.5,
      popup       = ~paste0(
        "Monitoring Location: ", Monitoring.Location.ID
      )
      # clusterOptions removed to show every point at all zoom levels
    )
}
```

```{R show depth distribution}
#| code-summary: Show depth distribution
library('ggplot2')
library(scales)

# Add depth data to summary
has_depth <- !all(is.na(df$Activity.Depth))
summary_data$has_depth_data <- has_depth

if (has_depth) {
  depth_stats <- df %>% 
    filter(!is.na(Activity.Depth)) %>%
    summarise(
      min_depth = min(Activity.Depth, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_depth = max(Activity.Depth, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_depth = mean(Activity.Depth, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  summary_data$depth_range <- list(
    min = round(depth_stats$min_depth, 1),
    max = round(depth_stats$max_depth, 1),
    mean = round(depth_stats$mean_depth, 1)
  )
}

reverselog_trans <- function(base = 10) {
  trans_new(
    name = "reverselog",
    transform = function(x) -log(x, base),
    inverse = function(x) base^(-x),
    breaks = log_breaks(base = base),
    domain = c(1e-100, Inf)
  )
}

ggplot(df, aes(y = Activity.Depth + 0.1)) +  # + tiny offset to prevent log10(0) errors
  geom_histogram(fill = "#427355", colour = "white", bins = 30) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = reverselog_trans(10), labels = function(x) round(x)) +
  labs(
    y = "Activity Depth (log scale)",
    x = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of Activity Depth"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{R, show co-occurrence matrix}
source(here::here("R/mutateWINTo2025.R"))

if (!("Org.Decimal.Latitude" %in% names(df))) {
  df$Org.Decimal.Latitude <- as.numeric(NA)
}

if (!("Org.Decimal.Longitude" %in% names(df))) {
  df$Org.Decimal.Longitude <- as.numeric(NA)
}

if (!("Activity.Depth" %in% names(df))) {
  df$Activity.Depth <- as.numeric(NA)
}

if (!("DEP.Result.Unit" %in% names(df))) {
  df$DEP.Result.Unit <- NA
}

df_long <- mutateWINTo2025(df)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Pivot to wide format using the actual column names from dashboardData.csv
# Columns: source, site, datetime, analyte, value, units, sample_depth
df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(source, site, datetime, units, sample_depth),
    names_from = analyte,
    values_from = value,
    values_fn = mean  # aggregate duplicates by taking mean
  )

#| code-summary: create identifier column
df_wide$site_id <- paste(
  df_wide$source, 
  df_wide$site, 
  ifelse(is.na(df_wide$sample_depth), "NA", df_wide$sample_depth), 
  sep = "-"
)

# desired remaining columns: analytes, datetime, site_id, depth
# Get analyte column names (all columns except listed)
id_columns <- c("source", "site", "units", "latitude", "longitude", "sample_depth", "site_id", "datetime")
analyte_columns <- setdiff(names(df_wide), id_columns)

# Keep only datetime, site_id, sample_depth, and all analyte columns
df_wide <- df_wide %>%
  select(site_id, datetime, sample_depth, all_of(analyte_columns))

# Display first 100 rows with scrolling
DT::datatable(
  head(df_wide, 100),
  options = list(
    scrollX = TRUE,
    scrollY = "400px",
    pageLength = 10
  ),
  caption = "Cleaned wide format data with selected columns (scroll to see all columns)"
)



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. compute analyte order (most -> least)
analyte_order <- df_wide %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(analyte_columns), ~ sum(!is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Analyte", values_to = "Count") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count)) %>%
  pull(Analyte)

# 2. presence matrix using sorted analytes
presence <- df_wide %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(analyte_order),
                ~ !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))) %>%
  select(all_of(analyte_order))

# 3. co-occurrence matrix (rows/cols are in analyte_order)
cooccurrence_matrix <- t(presence) %*% as.matrix(presence)

# 4. tidy it and set factor levels explicitly
cooccurrence_df <- as.data.frame(cooccurrence_matrix) %>%
  mutate(Analyte1 = row.names(.)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Analyte1,
               names_to = "Analyte2",
               values_to = "Cooccurrence") %>%
  mutate(
    Analyte1 = factor(Analyte1, levels = analyte_order),
    Analyte2 = factor(Analyte2, levels = analyte_order)
  ) %>%
  # Keep only the lower triangle (row >= column)
  filter(as.numeric(Analyte1) <= as.numeric(Analyte2))

# 5. plot with y-axis reversed
ggplot(cooccurrence_df, aes(x = Analyte1, y = Analyte2, fill = Cooccurrence)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rainbow(7)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cooccurrence_df$Analyte2))) +  # <-- reverse y-axis
  labs(
    title = "Analyte Co-occurrence Matrix",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Co-occurrence"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, size = 6, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```

# SEACAR Quality Assurance & Known Issues
```{R, Check for missing values}
# define generic checkcol function
checkColumn <- function(df, colName) {

  if (!colName %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Column", colName, "not found in dataframe"))
  }

  vals <- df[[colName]]
  n <- length(vals)
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(vals))
  pct_missing <- (n_missing / n) * 100

  # --- HEADER ---------------------------------------------------------------
  cat("\n## Column:", colName, "\n")
  cat(sprintf("**Missing values:** %d (%.2f%%)",
              n_missing, pct_missing))

  # --- SHOW TABLE OF MISSING ROWS (QUARTO-FRIENDLY) -------------------------
  if (n_missing > 0) {
    tbl <- head(df[is.na(vals), , drop = FALSE])

    # print() forces Quarto/knitr to display the table even inside functions
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        tbl,
        format = "simple",
        caption = paste("**First rows with", colName, "missing:")
      )
    )

    cat("\n---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}


# convert data to SEACAR format
source(here::here("R/mutateWINToSEACAR.R"))
df_seacar <- mutateWINToSEACAR(df)

# call checkCol fn on important columns:
cols <- 

lapply(
  c("ProgramID", "SampleDate", "ResultValue",
          "OriginalLatitude", "OriginalLongitude",
          "ProgramLocationID", "ParameterUnits"), 
  function(col){
    checkColumn(df_seacar, col)
  }
)
```
